consent.v1.body:
Namaste! I'm Dawai Saathi 💊 I help you understand prescriptions and lab reports.

Before we start:
• I save the photos you send, the medicine details I read from them, and your reminders.
• Photos are deleted automatically after {{retention_days}} days.
• I am not a doctor and I never diagnose. Always check with your doctor or pharmacist.
• Send DELETE any time to erase all your data.

Privacy policy: {{privacy_url}}

Do you agree?
consent.v1.accepted_welcome:
Thank you! 🙏 You can now:
📷 Send a photo of a prescription or lab report
💊 Send MEDS to see your medicines
❓ Send HELP to see all commands

I only explain what is written. Please confirm everything with your doctor or pharmacist.
consent.v1.declined: Okay, no problem. I will not read or save any of your documents. Whenever you change your mind, just send any message and I will ask again.
consent.v1.reminder: To read your documents I first need your permission. Nothing you sent has been opened or saved. Please choose an option below.
help.body:
I'm Dawai Saathi 💊

I can:
• Read a prescription photo and explain it simply
• Explain a lab report (never a diagnosis)
• Suggest cheaper generics with the same salt

Commands:
HELP – this message
MEDS – your active medicines
CHECK – check your medicines against each other (interactions, same medicine twice)
LANGUAGE – change language
STOP REMINDERS / START REMINDERS
REMINDERS – see or pause your dose reminders
CAREGIVER +91XXXXXXXXXX – add a family contact (CAREGIVER REMOVE to remove)
DELETE – erase all your data

🚨 Emergency? Call 112 or 108.

I am not a doctor. Always ask your doctor or pharmacist before changing anything.
reminders.disabled: Dose reminders are switched off. Send START REMINDERS to turn them on again.
meds.none: You have no active medicines saved yet. Send a photo of your prescription to add them.
delete.confirm_question:
⚠️ This will permanently delete ALL your data: messages, photos, medicines and reminders. It cannot be undone.

Delete everything?
delete.expired: That confirmation has expired, so nothing was deleted. Send DELETE again if you still want to erase your data.
delete.done: Done. All your data has been deleted. If you message me again we will start fresh. Take care! 🙏
emergency.general: 🚨 This sounds like an emergency. Please call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) right now or go to the nearest hospital. Do not wait for a reply here: I am not a doctor and cannot help in an emergency.
emergency.self_harm: 💛 I'm really sorry you are going through this. You are not alone. Please call Tele-MANAS (free, 24x7) on 14416 now. If you are in immediate danger, call 112 or 108 or go to the nearest hospital.
common.next_step: What would you like to do next?
rx.wrong_ack: Thank you for telling me. I marked this prescription as "needs checking" and will not use its medicines for reminders. Please show the prescription to your pharmacist, or type the correct details here.
rx.generic_unavailable: I don't have generic suggestions saved for this prescription. Please send the photo again to check, or ask your pharmacist about cheaper options with the same salt.
rx.not_found: I could not find that prescription any more. Please send the photo again.
reminders.reason.not_active: not clear enough or marked wrong
reminders.reason.too_frequent: more than 4 times a day, please set it with your doctor
reminders.days_open: next {{count}} days, then I will ask if you want to continue
reminders.nothing_eligible:
None of the medicines on this prescription can get a reminder:{{skipped}}

Please check with your doctor or pharmacist.
reminders.set_done: ✅ Reminders are set. The first one is at {{first}}. Send REMINDERS to see or pause them, STOP REMINDERS to stop all.
reminders.set_but_off: Reminders are saved, but they are switched off right now. Send START REMINDERS to turn them on.
reminders.change_prompt: Send the times you want, for example: subah 7, raat 10 (or 7am 10pm, or 07:00 22:00).
reminders.change_ambiguous: I could not tell morning from evening. Please write for example “subah 7, raat 10” or “07:00, 22:00”.
reminders.change_invalid: I could not understand those times. Example: “subah 7, raat 10” or “07:00, 22:00”.
reminders.change_too_few: You gave {{given}} time(s), but a medicine on this prescription needs {{needed}} a day. Please send {{needed}} times.
reminders.change_expired: That request expired. Please tap “Set reminders” under your prescription again.
reminders.list_none: You have no reminders yet. Send a prescription photo and tap “Set reminders”.
reminders.list_pick: Tap to pause or resume a reminder:
reminders.paused_one: Paused. Send REMINDERS to resume it.
reminders.caregiver_line: Family contacts: {{verified}} active, {{pending}} waiting for a reply.
reminder.ack_snooze: Okay, I will remind you again in {{minutes}} minutes.
reminder.snooze_limit: You have already snoozed twice. Please take your medicine when you can and tap “Le li”.
reminder.snooze_quiet: It is late, so I will not remind you again tonight. Please take your medicine when you can.
reminder.expired: That reminder is not open any more.
reminder.renew_body: Your medicine reminders end tomorrow. Do you want to continue them for {{days}} more days?
reminder.renew_no: Okay. Your reminders will end as planned.
caregiver.usage: To add a family contact send: CAREGIVER +91XXXXXXXXXX
caregiver.invalid_number: That does not look like an Indian mobile number. Please send: CAREGIVER +91XXXXXXXXXX
caregiver.own_number: That is your own number. Please send a family member's number.
caregiver.limit: You can add up to 2 family contacts. Send CAREGIVER REMOVE to remove them first.
caregiver.already: This person is already added or is waiting to reply.
caregiver.ask_label: What does this person call you? (for example Papa, Mummy, Dadaji). This is the only name they will see.
caregiver.label_invalid: Please send just a short name (letters only, up to 20 characters), for example: Papa.
caregiver.flow_expired: That request expired. Please send CAREGIVER +91XXXXXXXXXX again.
caregiver.invite_sent: I have sent them a request. They become your family contact only after they reply YES. If you miss doses repeatedly they get a short note, never your medicine names.
caregiver.user_verified: ✅ Your family contact said YES. They will get a short note if you miss doses repeatedly.
caregiver.user_declined: Your family contact said no, so they will not get any alerts.
caregiver.user_expired: Your family contact did not reply within 48 hours, so I cancelled the request. Send CAREGIVER +91XXXXXXXXXX to try again.
caregiver.user_stopped: Your family contact has stopped the alerts.
caregiver.removed: Removed. They will not get any more messages from me.
caregiver.none_to_remove: You have no family contact to remove.
caregiver.cg_verified: Thank you 🙏 You will get a short note if {{label}} misses doses repeatedly. Reply STOP ALERTS any time to stop.
caregiver.cg_declined: Okay, no problem. You will not get any messages.
caregiver.cg_stopped: Done. You will not get any more alerts.
caregiver.cg_expired: This request has expired. Please ask them to send it again.
reminders.unclear_item: a medicine that could not be read clearly
reminder.daily_summary: Today you took {{taken}} of {{total}} doses. Send REMINDERS to see your reminders.
interaction.details_prompt: I found interaction notes for these medicines. Do you want the full details?
interaction.details_none: There are no active interaction notes saved for your medicines. Send CHECK to check them again.
check.need_two: I need at least two active medicines to check them against each other. Send a photo of your prescription to add them.
meds.list_header_warn: Your active medicines (⚠️ = possible interaction or the same medicine twice; send CHECK for details):
